package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/parsers"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/tech"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// TechHandler exposes tech endpoints.
type TechHandler struct {
	Validator *validator.Validate
	CreateUC  tech.CreateTech
	GetUC     tech.GetTechByLabel
	GetByIDUC tech.GetTechByID
	UpdateUC  tech.UpdateTech
	DeleteUC  tech.DeleteTech
	ListUC    tech.ListTechs
}

type createTechRequest struct {
	Label string `json:"label" validate:"required,max=64"`
}

// Create handles POST /tech/create.
func (h TechHandler) Create(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req createTechRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	techEntity, err := h.CreateUC.Handle(r.Context(), tech.CreateTechInput{Label: req.Label})
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"id": techEntity.ID, "label": techEntity.Label})
}

// Get handles GET /tech/get?label=go.
func (h TechHandler) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	label := r.URL.Query().Get("label")
	if label == "" {
		http.Error(w, "label is required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	techEntity, err := h.GetUC.Handle(r.Context(), label)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"id": techEntity.ID, "label": techEntity.Label})
}

// GetByID handles GET /tech/get-by-id/{techID}.
func (h TechHandler) GetByID(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := chi.URLParam(r, "techID")
	parsedID, err := parsePositiveIntPathParam(id, "techID")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	techEntity, err := h.GetByIDUC.Handle(r.Context(), parsedID)
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"id": techEntity.ID, "label": techEntity.Label, "created_at": techEntity.CreatedAt})
}

type updateTechRequest struct {
	Label string `json:"label" validate:"required,max=64"`
}

// Update handles PUT /tech/update/{techID}.
func (h TechHandler) Update(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := chi.URLParam(r, "techID")
	parsedID, err := parsePositiveIntPathParam(id, "techID")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	var req updateTechRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	techEntity, err := h.UpdateUC.Handle(r.Context(), tech.UpdateTechInput{ID: parsedID, Label: req.Label})
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"id": techEntity.ID, "label": techEntity.Label})
}

// Delete handles DELETE /tech/delete/{techID}.
func (h TechHandler) Delete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := chi.URLParam(r, "techID")
	parsedID, err := parsePositiveIntPathParam(id, "techID")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.DeleteUC.Handle(r.Context(), parsedID); err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

// List handles GET /tech/list.
func (h TechHandler) List(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	fieldsParam := r.URL.Query().Get("fields")
	f := queryfields.Parse(fieldsParam, queryfields.TechAllowedFields)
	filters, err := parsers.ParseTechFilters(r, h.Validator)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	techs, total, err := h.ListUC.Handle(r.Context(), filters)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	if techs == nil {
		techs = []domain.Tech{}
	}
	items := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(techs))
	for _, t := range techs {
		item := map[string]any{}
		if f.Has("id") {
			item["id"] = t.ID
		}
		if f.Has("label") {
			item["label"] = t.Label
		}
		if f.Has("created_at") {
			item["created_at"] = t.CreatedAt
		}
		items = append(items, item)
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
		"techs": items,
		"meta":  buildPaginationMeta(filters.Page, filters.Limit, total),
	})
}
